prompt: Scaffold a custom connector that ingests articles from our internal CMS (Postgres-backed REST API at api.internal/articles) into a Gemini Enterprise datastore. ~50k articles, hourly updates.

assertions.name: picks_ingestion_connector
assertions.text: Picks the ingestion connector path (Fetch → Transform → Sync into Discovery Engine), not an MCP server.

assertions.name: gcs_jsonl_import_not_inline
assertions.text: Uses GCS JSONL import (GcsSource) rather than inline import for the sync, given 50k documents — explicitly or implicitly explains why inline doesn't scale.

assertions.name: stable_doc_ids_from_article_id
assertions.text: Derives stable document IDs from the CMS article primary key, not random UUIDs.

assertions.name: paginated_rest_fetch
assertions.text: Implements paginated reads from the REST API rather than assuming a single response.

assertions.name: watermark_for_incremental_sync
assertions.text: Uses a watermark (e.g., updated_at) and INCREMENTAL reconciliation mode for hourly syncs, with a FULL first run.

assertions.name: scheduling_mechanism
assertions.text: Recommends a concrete scheduling mechanism (Cloud Scheduler → Cloud Run Job) for the hourly cadence.

assertions.name: acl_strategy_explicit
assertions.text: Makes the ACL strategy explicit — either idp_wide=True (if articles are org-wide readable) or per-document readers — not silently skipping ACL configuration.

assertions.name: acl_enabled_at_creation
assertions.text: Sets acl_enabled=True at datastore creation time.

assertions.name: deletes_handled
assertions.text: Addresses how deletes are handled (PurgeDocuments, periodic FULL re-sync, or explicit acknowledgment that the source is append-only).
